news.headline: Sources: Raiders not planning on trading Maxx Crosby, who wants to stay
news.description: The Raiders do not plan on trading Maxx Crosby, who wants to stay in Las Vegas, sources told ESPN.

news.headline: Patriots rule out A.J. Brown, TreVeyon Henderson vs. Dolphins
news.description: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins. In addition, No. 2 running back TreVeyon Henderson has been ruled out due to an illness.

news.headline: NFL to review additional allegations against Packers RB Josh Jacobs
news.description: The NFL said it will look into additional allegations of physical and verbal abuse by Packers RB Josh Jacobs that were revealed as part of a public records release from the Hobart/Lawrence Police Department.

news.headline: Records show 3 other women accused Packers' Josh Jacobs of abuse after arrest
news.description: Three other women contacted police to detail allegations of abuse against Packers RB Josh Jacobs following his May arrest for an altercation with his then-girlfriend.
